text_block_list.text: I handed Mejiro McQueen the fan letter that had arrived for her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have read your letter.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...It certainly makes one sit up straighter,
hearing these voices of expectation. And—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Cheers are the guideposts to our dreams"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
These words my grandmother once told me...
I feel like I've gotten just a little closer to their true meaning.
choice_data_list: The sender will be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then I must repay these feelings
in the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, I'll be training you rigorously today as well!

That day, Mejiro McQueen happily dedicated herself
to her training from start to finish.
